column1: Inclusion criteria for cases (data platforms and data ecosystems):
The initiative is focused on B2B data exchange (not purely B2C).
There is actual data sharing, access provision, or trading of data between independent parties.
The initiative is aimed at inter-organizational data exchange rather than internal data storage or analytics within a single organization.
The initiative has an explicitly defined structure with identifiable roles, data flows, and interaction mechanisms.
There are governance mechanisms (agreements, standards, or rules) regarding access, usage, and data characteristics.
The initiative is operational, not purely conceptual, or sufficiently documented in literature and practice to enable systematic coding.
There is sufficient publicly available information (e.g., website, technical documentation, reports, academic papers) to enable classification against all taxonomy dimensions.
